Name: Jeremiah, Second Captain of Gad
Summary: Tenth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 12:13: Tenth captain of the Gadites who separated themselves to David in the wilderness.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jeremiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
